# Use platform-standard directories instead of hardcoded ~/.bivvy

## Context

Two locations use `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy")` for user-level data, which violates platform conventions (XDG on Linux, `~/Library/Application Support` on macOS, `AppData` on Windows). The rest of the codebase already uses proper platform directories — cache, sessions, and feedback all use `dirs::cache_dir()` or `dirs::data_local_dir()`. This change makes the remaining two locations consistent.

## Changes

### 1. User global config: `src/config/loader.rs`

**`find_user_global()` (line 47-54)**: Change from `dirs::home_dir()?.join(".bivvy")` to `dirs::config_dir()?.join("bivvy")`.

This moves the user global config from `~/.bivvy/config.yml` to the platform config directory:
- Linux: `~/.config/bivvy/config.yml`
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/config.yml`
- Windows: `C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\bivvy\config.yml`

Update doc comments on `ConfigPaths` struct (lines 18, 25) and `load_merged_config` (line 195) that reference `~/.bivvy/config.yml`.

### 2. Project state: `src/state/store.rs`

**`state_dir()` (line 118-124)**: Change from `dirs::home_dir().join(".bivvy").join("projects")` to `dirs::data_local_dir().join("bivvy").join("projects")`.

This moves project state from `~/.bivvy/projects/{hash}/` to the platform data directory:
- Linux: `~/.local/share/bivvy/projects/{hash}/`
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/projects/{hash}/`
- Windows: `C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\bivvy\projects/{hash}/`

Using `data_local_dir()` is consistent with how sessions and feedback are already stored.

Update the fallback from `PathBuf::from("~")` to `PathBuf::from(".")` (consistent with session/feedback fallbacks — `~` doesn't expand in PathBuf anyway).

### 3. Tests

Add a test in each file verifying the path uses the correct platform directory (not `home_dir`):
- `config/loader.rs`: Test that `find_user_global` looks under `config_dir()`
- `state/store.rs`: Test that `state_dir` is under `data_local_dir()`

Existing tests use `TempDir` and are unaffected by the path changes.

## Files to modify

- `src/config/loader.rs` — `find_user_global()` + doc comments
- `src/state/store.rs` — `state_dir()` + fallback

## Verification

```sh
cargo test --all-features
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
cargo fmt -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo build --all-targets --all-features
cargo build --release
```
